﴿Alladhi khalaqaka﴾: i.e., after you had not been.

﴿Fa-sawwaka﴾: i.e., made you proportioned in form, sound in limbs.

﴿Fa-'adalaka﴾: i.e., made you well-balanced in creation, proportioned in limbs, with no hand longer or leg longer than the other.
